mechanism_purpose: Convert petroleum cash flows into diversified financial assets while integrating withdrawals with fiscal framework
core_design_feature: Net state petroleum cash to GPFG with fiscal guideline linked to expected real return
main_prerequisite: Deep institutions; mature tax system; large liquid fund
main_failure_mode: Using mature-state spending rule without comparable buffers or institutions
transferability_note: Transfer the integration principle, not a headline percentage

mechanism_purpose: Separate near-term stabilization from intergenerational saving
core_design_feature: Petroleum Holding Fund architecture with Stabilisation and Heritage Funds
main_prerequisite: Reliable petroleum revenue reporting and parliamentary rules
main_failure_mode: Rules weakened by repeated exceptions or weak integration with budget
transferability_note: Useful mechanism comparison for separate objectives

mechanism_purpose: Manage finite petroleum wealth in a small economy
core_design_feature: Petroleum Fund with public reporting and portfolio structure
main_prerequisite: Long-run fiscal planning and discipline on withdrawals
main_failure_mode: Professionally managed fund can coexist with unsustainable budget dependence
transferability_note: Strong small-state warning on withdrawal path

mechanism_purpose: Use pre-production window to prepare institutions and infrastructure
core_design_feature: Staatsolie role and GranMorgu development before first oil
main_failure_mode: Assuming planned startup/revenue is already observed
transferability_note: Regional comparison for readiness, not operating outcomes

mechanism_purpose: Manage resource cycles and heritage/stabilization objectives
core_design_feature: Heritage and Stabilisation Fund plus mature energy institutions
main_failure_mode: Copying downstream industrial model without market/feedstock scale
transferability_note: Mechanism comparison, not automatic development pathway

mechanism_purpose: Combine new production, state participation, transparency and local content
core_design_feature: PETROSEN participation plus revenue law and EITI disclosure
main_prerequisite: SOE financing transparency and project-level reconciliation
main_failure_mode: Opaque state-participation debt or production-share flows
transferability_note: Useful for state equity and first-oil transparency

mechanism_purpose: Build hydrocarbon tax and fund capability around cross-border LNG
core_design_feature: Hydrocarbon revenue administration plus EITI/public fund oversight
main_failure_mode: Oil-style revenue controls may miss LNG chain complexity
transferability_note: Useful for gas and shared-field states

mechanism_purpose: Use long preparation window for law, regulator, fund, local content and environment
core_design_feature: Petroleum Authority, Petroleum Fund, EITI and project preparation
main_prerequisite: Institutional continuity over long lead time
main_failure_mode: Preparation documents do not guarantee operating performance
transferability_note: Shows what can be built when first oil is delayed

mechanism_purpose: Combine development spending, stabilization and saving
core_design_feature: Law 1/2024 transfer formula and international investment architecture
main_prerequisite: Budget integration, central-bank operations, parliamentary reporting
main_failure_mode: Complex rules can fail if implementation/reporting lag

mechanism_purpose: Smooth commodity-cycle revenue through structural fiscal rule
core_design_feature: Cyclically adjusted revenues, stabilization fund and debt anchor
main_prerequisite: Credible estimation and medium-term fiscal institutions
main_failure_mode: Rule can be weakened by persistent deficits or depleted buffers
transferability_note: Transfer smoothing principle, not copper formula

mechanism_purpose: Preserve mineral wealth and external buffers
main_prerequisite: Persistent fiscal savings and external reserves
main_failure_mode: Buffers can erode over long periods of deficits/resource weakness
